hints.title: Bijection Mapping Equivalence
hints.text: The mapping between pattern characters and words in string s must be a one-to-one and onto bijection.

hints.title: Dual Mapping Consistency Verification
hints.text: Track both pattern-character-to-word and word-to-pattern-character associations simultaneously to prevent multiple characters sharing a single word.

hints.title: Word Tokenization and Conflict Check
hints.text: Split s into tokens. If count of tokens does not equal length of pattern, return false. For each pair, verify that existing mappings agree with the current pair, otherwise set them.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: M: total length of words in s
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N + M) time and O(N + M) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A single one-way map fails when distinct pattern letters map to the same word.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual tracking guarantees bijection consistency in a single pass through the tokens.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize bijection requirements and handle token count discrepancies as an immediate early exit.
